textTemplates.name: CompleteStaffPage_description
textTemplates.text:
KW to update with current process info

"If dealer has a staff page, or wants, one, we will need to:

1) Create a staff folder in Image Library > 01 Banner Images > 01. Primary Sites > 00. Dealer. > Dealer Name > Staff (this will be the new folder you create)

2) Go to the staff page on existing site and pull all images, names, titles, etc. (Right click on the image and select ""save image as"" - can only download in jpeg or png format. If the image downloads in webp format, I recommend this nifty extension for Chrome: https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/save-image-as-png/nkokmeaibnajheohncaamjggkanfbphi?hl=en. 3) Make sure the staff images are no larger than 230x230 - can be smaller than this, but if they're larger, it will throw off the layout of the page.

4) Upload all staff images to the folder you created in step 1 above. (i know)

5) Go to Content Management > Staff Members and click ""Add New Staff Member"". NOTE: 99% of the time you won't have to worry about the ""Add New Staff Category"" option, as most staff categories are already available when you go to tadd the new staff member.

6) Enter name, role, and select category from the dropdown. Use the image select option to navigate to your staff images folder and select the corresponding image. (PRO TIP: If you have multiple screens, put Apollo on one screen and the dealer's existing staff page on the other and then just copy/paste the info.

7) Repeat step 6 for all staff members (i know...)."

textTemplates.name: GettingStartedCallPrimaryWebsiteSection_description
textTemplates.text:
Dedicate at least 15 minutes of GSC to website to go over: go dark/go live date, access to domain registrar, whether or not a zone file is needed, website tools, design selection (reference OEM guidelines) and set general expectations

- Confirm Website Tools & Integrations: Digital Retailing, Finance Application, Value Trade, Service Scheduler, Chat / Text, etc. Do any integrations need to be set up such as xTime, DealerTrack, RouteOne, etc.

- Confirm if we should copy current SRP & VDP disclaimers

- Confirm if any scripts such as GTM, ComplyAuto, tracking pixels, etc. will need to be moved to the new site

- Confirm Domain registrar access

- Confirm Primary Domain & any other domains that need to be pointed

- Review OEM approved website designs

- Discuss any specific requirements for the new website

- Set Target Website Review Date
